item.text:
Completed the ParaView/TTK workflow.

- Original scalar field, Viridis: [ionization_original_viridis.png](/workspace/ionization_original_viridis.png)
- Simplified piecewise-linear contour tree: [ionization_simplified_contour_tree.png](/workspace/ionization_simplified_contour_tree.png)
- Reopenable ParaView state: [ionization_contour_tree.pvsm](/workspace/ionization_contour_tree.pvsm)
- Reproducible rendering script: [render_ionization.py](/workspace/render_ionization.py)

The state imports all 21 Ionization frames, applies normalized persistence simplification of 0.1, and uses radius-2 glyphs with the requested critical-point colors and edge thickness 1.
